Senior Backend Engineer (Payments)
FinLane GmbH — Berlin, Germany (hybrid, 3 days per week in the office)

FinLane builds payment processing infrastructure for European online retailers.
We are looking for a senior backend engineer to own core transaction services.

Requirements:
- 5+ years of backend development experience
- Strong TypeScript and Node.js skills
- Production experience with PostgreSQL and Redis
- Hands-on AWS experience (ECS, RDS)
- Docker-based deployments and CI/CD pipelines
- Fluent English (C1)

Nice to have:
- Experience in fintech or payments
- Kubernetes
- German language skills
